coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Niger’s official Interior Ministry decentralisation handbook lists the Ville de Maradi as a distinct city-level local authority. An official ANP report describes a Maradi City land-affairs committee with participation from cadastral services and city/resident representation. National DGI materials list Maradi regional tax offices and cadastral functions, but none of these sources identifies an exact city-level title registry or public parcel-map service. Under the local-evidence threshold, registry existence is left unresolved (null).
